personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe glowing surfaces
personality_one_liner: A high-performance, neon-accented dark dashboard that blends live operational utility with premium, glowing glassmorphism.

spacing.rule: Use tight spacing for metric groupings and generous padding for distinct card boundaries. Never let content crowd the safe areas.

do's: Use heavy tint + blur for sticky headers and bottom tabs
Apply subtle glowing linear gradients to card borders or behind major metrics
Ensure text on glass has high-contrast white to maintain readability
dont's: Don't stack glass on top of glass
Don't blur dense data tables or lists of transactions
Don't rely on blur alone—always pair it with a dark translucent base (e.g., 80% opacity surfaceSecondary)

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Log in or register with email/Google, featuring a deep neon branded hero background.

states.loading: Spinner centered on deep navy background.
states.error: Error toast using #FF4757 surface with white text.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical dark gradient scrim overlay (transparent to #0A0E1A). Bottom 60% contains email/password inputs (surfaceTertiary) and neon purple primary button. Google Sign-In as secondary outline button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level summary of financial health, balances, and cashflow in a stacked mobile layout.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and charts.
states.empty: Empty state illustration of a glowing 3D wallet with 'Tambahkan transaksi pertama Anda'.
states.error: Card showing connection failure with retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top: Welcome + Financial Health ring (glowing green/orange). Next: Pemasukan (Green) and Pengeluaran (Red) side-by-side or stacked summary cards. Middle: Cashflow Line Chart (Blue/Purple neon lines). Bottom: Horizontal scrolling Savings Jars (Tabungan) using glassmorphism cards.

screens.name: Transaksi
screens.purpose: List and filter all income and expense transactions chronologically.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty receipt list.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with horizontal scrollable filter chips (Semua, Pemasukan, Pengeluaran). List rows grouped by Date. Each row has a brand-tinted icon circle, Title, Category, and positive/negative amount styled with success/error tokens. FAB at bottom right to add transaction.

screens.name: Belanja
screens.purpose: Manage monthly shopping lists and budget realization.
screens.layout: Accessed via Drawer. Cards for each category (e.g., Groceries, Toiletries) featuring a progress bar (filling with brandSecondary/blue as budget gets used). Items listed below each category card.

screens.name: Tagihan
screens.purpose: Track upcoming and paid bills grouped by status.

states.empty: Illustration of no pending bills. 'Semua tagihan lunas!'

screens.layout: Tab view or segmented control for Status: Segera Jatuh Tempo, Belum Dibayar, Terlambat, Lunas. Cards with bill logo/icon, due date, amount, and a pill-shaped status badge.

screens.name: Pendidikan
screens.purpose: Track education budgets per child (SPP, Uang Saku, etc.).
screens.layout: Accessed via Drawer. Horizontal scroll of child profiles at the top. Below, a categorized list of expenses (SPP, Buku, Les) with amounts and progress vs allocated budget.

screens.name: Tabungan
screens.purpose: Visualize savings goals via jar metaphors.
screens.layout: Grid (2-col) of 'Jar' cards. Each card has an icon, Goal Name, Amount Saved / Target Amount, and a neon-filled progress ring or bar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Theme Rule: Enforce the 'Dark-First Utility' aesthetic explicitly. Use the deep navy #0A0E1A background base. Let the neon accents (success/error/brand) serve as high-contrast indicators for finance metrics.

Typography: Use Space Grotesk for large numeric amounts (e.g., Rp3.750.000) and headers to enhance the modern tech/dashboard vibe. Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all standard body text, labels, and lists to maintain high legibility.

Desktop-to-Mobile Adaptation: Convert the side-by-side desktop dashboard into a stacked mobile layout. Ensure the Financial Health and Saving Rate are positioned prominently at the top. Use horizontal scrolling for the Tabungan jars to save vertical space.

Glassmorphism Rule: Use expo-blur with a heavily tinted surfaceSecondary (#12182B) overlay for sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, and the Drawer menu. Ensure text readability with high-contrast white.

Cards & Borders: Give cards a surfaceSecondary background. For emphasis on key metric cards (like Financial Health or Total Saldo), apply a subtle glowing border utilizing the brandPrimary or brandSecondary colors with linear gradients.
Image Overlay: On the Auth screen, apply a gradient scrim over the auth_hero image from transparent at the top to solid #0A0E1A at the bottom so the login inputs are perfectly readable.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all tabs and transaction list items, employing tinted circular backgrounds (brandTertiary at 15% opacity) to hold the icons in the list rows.
Ensure 'Drawer' navigation is properly configured within Expo Router to handle Belanja, Pendidikan, Laporan, Analisis, and Pengaturan, while Tabs handle the core features.
